fi-poecilia-reticulata.title: Guppy
fi-poecilia-reticulata.summary: The guppy, Poecilia reticulata, is a livebearer native to northeastern South America and the southern Caribbean, including Venezuela and Trinidad. One of the most popular aquarium fish in the world,…
rows: Wild fish are primarily insectivorous, but today's tank-bred fish are far-removed from their ancestors and will accept most foods offered.
Native to northeastern South America and the southern Caribbean with its original range considered to cover Venezuela , Guyana , Suriname , French Guiana plus the islands of…
notes: Unfussy, though a planted tank with floating vegetation is appreciated.

fi-poecilia-wingei.title: Endler's Livebearer
fi-poecilia-wingei.summary: Endler's livebearer, Poecilia wingei, is a small livebearer from the Campoma and Buena Vista lagoons in northeastern Venezuela. It hybridises with the guppy, P. reticulata, to produce fertile…
rows: Omnivore. An omnivorous species, feeding on a variety of zoobenthos and detritus in the wild.
Occurs in fresh waters in the Campoma and Buena Vista lagoons unto Carupano, in northeastern Venezuela .
notes: A planted setup is strongly recommended as are floating plants.
Water flow is not a problem for these fish as they are very active and should not be kept in aquaria smaller than that suggested above.
